1936, May
FATHER SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 6.
Page 113 Cont.
May 10 Mrs. L. Livernois - 40 - widow with five small ch. - asthma - kid- ney etc. Sister-in-law a pius Lutheran - conscientious with heart trouble.
Mrs. Anna Hillenbrand of Toledo - 62 - Mother of 8 - one in convent - Cancer of rectum operation 3 yrs. ago. In fearful pain now 3 months - Enrolled $5.00 Today.
Mrs. Anna Van Winkle - - ? Convert about 4 yrs. Both breasts off ... Seems O.K. but now Siatic rhumatism.
Page 114
Apr. 21 Frank Catanzaro - 36 - has quite a family to support.
23 Mrs. Fitzpatrick - 50 - heart, etc. husband died of cancer Palm Sunday
24 John Ochocki - 77 - Cancer of stomach - suffers terribly
25 Josephine Thomas - 22 - knocked down a year & half ago, broken leg and badly bruised; bone fails to knit. now 9 mo. in cast ........ Mrs. Clara Nichols - 31 - almost totaly blind - double cateracts ... husband in Eloise ....
Marie Rose Stumm - 6 - serious kidney trouble ... . .
Mrs. Hilder Scheid - 57 - bad tuomer of breast - fears operation - Husband + 2 yrs.
Page 115 May 27 Antonia Joly - 54 - fears loss of hearing ..... now in Ann Arbor. ..
Page 116
May 29 Ch's. Pearce - 55 - Episcopelian, Siatic rheumatism. in fearful pain. So fearful that out of head took gas- luckyly wife and son found him before too late. (Tuesday 12 of May) Enrolled To-day 1.00
30 Patrick J. Bellman - 12 mo. no apetite ... no teeth - no words of speech - losing weight ... Enrolled To-day
31 Mrs. Mary Kliemann - 75 - beaten out of property
